name: Oklahoma
overview: Oklahoma's property-tax refund is an owner-only circuit breaker with a narrow household-income limit.

programs.name: Credit or Refund of Property Tax (Form 538-H)
programs.ageRule: Head of household age 65 or older, or totally disabled; form also asks whether claimant or spouse is 65 or older.
programs.incomeDefinition: Gross taxable and nontaxable income and assistance of all household members, excluding gifts.
programs.formulaSummary: Refunds qualifying homestead real-estate taxes exceeding 1% of gross household income, capped at $200.
programs.application: File Form 538-H by June 30, 2026 for 2025 taxes; attach to Form 511 if required to file an income-tax return.
eligibilityNotes: Owner or joint owner must maintain the residence; renters do not qualify.
No late amended claim after the deadline.
programs.programYear: 2025 property taxes and household income; Form 538-H claim due June 30, 2026.
